description: List the workspace's webhook endpoints, newest first. Read-only and takes no input. Each endpoint carries its URL, events, enabled state and description; the URL may be shortened or withheld, because its query string can carry a secret. Signing secrets are never returned - create_webhook and rotate_webhook_secret show one once. An endpoint with enabled false receives no events. For delivery attempts and their status, use list_webhook_deliveries.
name: list_webhooks
title: List webhooks
